title: chore(verification): close proof drift surfaces (#1494)
body: ## What This Changes - Closes verification drift by wiring required checks into CI/`justfile` paths. - Updates verification docs and sink verification seams to match enforced expectations. ## Why Issue #1494 is about restoring alignment between documented verification requirements and enforced CI behavior. ## Testing - Not re-run in this integration pass. - Please run: `just ci`. ## Context - Implementation transcript: https://chatgpt.com/codex/tasks/task_e_69d577f8c5e0832ebb65a746949c4410 (attempt 1) > [!NOTE] > ### Extend Kani verification to cover fanout sink helpers across four crates > - Extracts fanout logic in [sink.rs](https://github.com/strawgate/memagent/pull/1570/files#diff-a001cff3f8c308de7cbe300055a1ddb36ee2bf6dc7cf99c700984afc22c8c88e) into two helpers (`merge_child_send_result`, `finalize_fanout_outcome`) and replaces prior variant-invariant proofs with focused Kani proofs for each helper. > - Expands CI and `just kani` to run Kani across `logfwd-core`, `logfwd-arrow`, `logfwd-io`, and `logfwd-output` instead of only `logfwd-core`. > - Updates the CI trigger path filter to include all four crates and the verification script, so the Kani job runs whenever relevant code changes. > > > > Macroscope summarized 354af69. > >
